methodology: NDBI = (SWIR_B11 - NIR_B08) / (SWIR_B11 + NIR_B08); mean_ndbi_near_channel is the mean NDBI of valid pixels within a fixed buffer of mapped waterways, tracked as a continuous value (not a built/not-built fraction) -- see module docstring for why a binary threshold was tried and dropped.

calibration_check.note: Sanity check only, not a tuned calibration: a positive correlation here means whole-cell mean NDBI tracks WorldCover's own built-up classification sensibly; it does not validate the per-year trend itself. See module docstring for the earlier (dropped) binary-threshold calibration attempts and why they failed.
